title: Cards that wrap themselves
why_it_matters: Wrapping rows are the base of most responsive card layouts.
explanation: flex-wrap lets items drop to the next line instead of squashing. The flex shorthand sets grow, shrink and basis. flex: 1 1 220px means: start at 220px wide, share leftover space, and shrink if needed. Cards wrap when there is no room.
try_it: Add six cards and resize the browser. Count how many fit per row at each width.
